<b>Winged Pilgrim Bellbearers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are pilgrims possessing large wings along with carrying a brace of bells.<ref>Winged Pilgrim Bellbearer [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Pilgrim endowed with large wings, carrying a brace of iron bells."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Winged Pilgrim Bellbearers either start off flying back and forth in a small area, or clinging to a wall and taking flight once Hornet comes near.<br>
Once they are targeting Hornet, they try to fly so they are diagonally above and away from Hornet, flying further away to keep their distance if she gets close. 

Once Hornet is in range, Winged Pilgrim Bellbearers toss an iron bell at her that travels in a heavy arc, bouncing off a surface once before breaking on the next impact. The bell can be hit back at the Pilgrim or any other enemies in the room, dealing the same amount of damage that a needle hit would.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Winged Pilgrim Bellbearers have their health doubled. They gain one of the following [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]]: Void Blades, Void Tendrils, or Void Projectiles.

== Location ==
Winged Pilgrim Bellbearers can mainly be found in the western areas of Pharloom, appearing twice in the vertical corridor west of the [[Shellwood]] Bellway, twice in a vertical area in the [[Wormways]], and again in the [[Blasted Steps]].<br>
During [[Act 3]], a Winged Pilgrim Bellbearer can be found in [[Greymoor]] in the tunnel east of [[Halfway Home]].

==Trivia==
* Winged Pilgrim Bellbearer is the longest enemy name in both <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i> and <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>, at 23 letters excluding spaces, tied with [[Forebrothers Signis & Gron]].
* Winged Pilgrim Bellbearers and their [[Choir Bellbearer|choir disciple counterparts]] have the same voicelines as the ground [[Pilgrim Bellbearer|Pilgrim Bellbearers]].
